the system of additional educational services of civil servants is in need of innovative transformation.

the innovative transformation of the education system of civil servants is possible only in the context of the implementation of the following principles: the focus on the development of the civil servant as a person; the use of the competence approach to the formation and development of professional competences of civil servants; transition to innovative educational technology.
the system of additional vocational training of civil servants is in need of modernization, which should be based on the principles of advanced education and innovative education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the concept of "innovative additional professional education" of civil servants.

the following issues: the need to develop and implement innovative approaches to the additional education of civil service; the need for the development and implementation of the competence-based approach to additional professional education; the need to introduce innovative educational technologies in the additional professional education of public service; the need to create a system of additional professional public education, which is based on the principles of advanced training.

the development of a conceptual model for the formation of professional skills civil servants in additional professional education, which is based on a competence-based approach and the use of innovative educational technologies, and the use of the results of the study to develop a program for the formation of a professional skills civil servants.

the innovative transformation of the additional professional education of the public servant is a necessary condition for the effective formation of their professional skills and professional development of civil servants.

it is necessary to develop a comprehensive system of additional professional training of civil servants, based on modern approaches to innovative education, which will ensure the formation of professional competencies and skills in the field of public administration.

the formation of professional skills and competencies of employees in the civil service should be carried out on the basis of innovative approaches, which include: focus on the modern concept of a civil servant, the use of competence approach and innovative educational technologies.
the formation of professional competence of employees in the system of additional vocational education of civil servants requires a comprehensive approach to its organization.

the innovative transformation of additional professional education in the public service should be aimed at the formation of a professional competence of civil servants, the use of modern information and educational technologies.

the formation of professional skills in civil servants should be based on a new conceptual approach, which implies the formation of the professional competence of civil servants in the framework of the competence model of the public service.
